description: This source file provides helper functions for device resource management, including URI creation, resource reading/writing, and endpoint handling within a device management SDK.

methods.name: createDeviceUri
methods.description: Creates a URI string for a device using its UUID.

methods.name: createEndpointUri
methods.description: Creates a URI string for a device endpoint using UUID and endpoint ID.

methods.name: createDeviceResourceUri
methods.description: Creates a URI for a device resource using UUID and resource ID.

methods.name: createDeviceMetadataUri
methods.description: Creates a URI for device metadata using UUID and metadata ID.

methods.name: createEndpointResourceUri
methods.description: Creates a URI for a resource on a specific endpoint.

methods.name: createEndpointMetadataUri
methods.description: Creates a URI for metadata on a specific endpoint.

methods.name: deviceHelperReadEndpointResource
methods.description: Reads a resource from a device's endpoint, caller frees value on success.

methods.name: deviceHelperWriteEndpointResource
methods.description: Writes a resource to a device's endpoint.

methods.name: deviceHelperReadDeviceResource
methods.description: Reads a resource from a device.

methods.name: deviceHelperReadResourceByUri
methods.description: Reads a resource directly by URI, caller frees value on success.

methods.name: deviceHelperGetResourceByUri
methods.description: Retrieves a resource by URI.

methods.name: deviceHelperReadMetadataByUri
methods.description: Reads metadata by URI, caller frees value on success.

methods.name: deviceHelperWriteMetadataByUri
methods.description: Writes metadata by URI.

methods.name: deviceHelperReadMetadataByOwner
methods.description: Reads metadata associated with an owner URI.

methods.name: deviceHelperWriteMetadataByOwner
methods.description: Writes metadata associated with an owner URI.

methods.name: fetchResource
methods.description: Helper function to fetch a resource from a URI.

methods.name: writeResource
methods.description: Helper function to write a resource to a URI.

methods.name: createResourceUri
methods.description: Creates a resource URI from owner URI and resource ID.

methods.name: getDeviceUuidFromUri
methods.description: Extracts device UUID from a URI.

methods.name: getEndpointIdFromUri
methods.description: Extracts endpoint ID from a URI.

methods.name: deviceHelperGetDeviceResourceValue
methods.description: Gets the value of a device resource, returns default if unavailable.

methods.name: deviceHelperGetEndpointResourceValue
methods.description: Gets the value of an endpoint resource, returns default if unavailable.

methods.name: deviceHelperGetEndpointByProfile
methods.description: Finds the first endpoint with a given profile.

methods.name: deviceHelperIsMultiEndpointCapable
methods.description: Checks if device supports multiple endpoints.
